svg.title: What Microsoft Intune manages on a Cloud PC
svg.desc: Four tasks in the Microsoft Intune admin center reach the Cloud PC, which is Microsoft Entra joined and enrolled in Intune. A settings catalog profile sets values such as an Edge setting, and the Cloud PC check is the effective value at edge://policy. An app assigned as Required or Available for enrolled devices is checked in the Company Portal Installed view. An update ring assigned to a device group is checked in Windows Update history. A remote action such as Restart is checked by reconnecting. Restore and reprovision lose data and are not tested on your only Cloud PC. The Cloud PC reports status and its last check-in back to Intune, shown as device status, app installation status, the update ring report and the Cloud PC actions report.
svg.text: Available: user picks it in Company Portal
Intune reports back, as separate evidence from the result on the Cloud PC
